purpose: Public sources motivating the controlled-health-data model-export workflow and privacy-audit caution. These sources are not a machine-readable legal rulebook and do not prove that BIO-022 is an accepted export-review method.

sources.title: 보건의료빅데이터개방시스템 의료영상 데이터 분석 지원 안내
sources.supported_use: Medical-image AI development can occur in a controlled GPU environment without exporting source image data; HIRA also exposes formal data-analysis application/review workflows.
sources.unsupported_use: Proof that BIO-022 methodology is accepted for model export approval.

sources.title: 맞춤형 연구자료 이용가이드
sources.supported_use: HIRA research-data workflows include a separate import/export application step after analysis approval.
sources.unsupported_use: Evidence that trained-model privacy attacks are currently mandatory in that export step.

sources.title: 공공데이터 제공 및 이용 업무 운영지침 — 반출신청서
sources.supported_use: A formal export-approval request exists for artifacts/results leaving controlled analysis workflows.
sources.unsupported_use: Proof that a model-security product is separately purchased today.

sources.title: 2026년 의료 AI 데이터 활용 바우처 지원사업 수요기관 2차 모집
sources.supported_use: The 2026 program connected 10 medical-AI SMEs with 45 participating medical-data-centered hospitals for data preparation/processing/analysis support, providing a concrete buyer/interview cohort signal.
sources.unsupported_use: Proof that those organizations need or would pay for BIO-022.

sources.title: AX 시대 의료데이터 활용 전략 모색
sources.supported_use: Public 2026 direction includes expanding data vouchers and creating AI-model validation through medical-data-centered hospitals.
sources.unsupported_use: A conclusion about the exact technical content of model-export privacy review.

sources.title: 2026 HIRA role/functions public material
sources.supported_use: Public workflow signal that AI models/algorithms may be exported while image data remain non-exportable and export review can involve external expertise.
sources.unsupported_use: A legal conclusion about any specific artifact.

sources.title: ML Privacy Meter
sources.supported_use: Membership-inference-based privacy auditing is an existing technique/tooling category.
sources.unsupported_use: Claim that this benchmark invents membership inference or that one attack is sufficient.

sources.title: 2026 medical-AI membership-inference research
sources.supported_use: Patient/record-level membership privacy risk can differ materially from aggregate privacy summaries.
sources.unsupported_use: Transfer of reported numerical risk to the synthetic BIO-022 fixture.

sources.title: 2026 membership-inference audit false-positive / data-split caution
sources.supported_use: Control experiments and split-bias checks are important when interpreting membership-inference audit signals.
sources.unsupported_use: A universal numeric threshold for privacy safety or export.
